title: 第三千八百九十二章自爆黑暗宇宙之灵第三千八百九十一章再疯狂一次
content_zh:
“别说是你了，就连我们也没有想到，黑暗主神会被逼到这种份上，即便是先前另外两大宇宙之主，都没有做出这般疯狂的举动。”
“而且黑暗宇宙成长至今所蕴含的能量难以想象，一旦让黑暗宇宙之灵自爆，必然是毁天灭地的伤害。”
“哪怕我们所有修士都释放体内神力抵挡，也无济于事。”
封杀神情凝重道。
一旁的姬玄也同样如此，他知道，眼下这种情况，说什么也来不及，只能看苏阳还有什么办法没。
与此同时，在死灵渊外的麒凌风等人也无比愕然。
天子更是目瞪口呆道：“黑暗主神难道就没有别的手段了？居然要用这种方式来结束这场战斗？”
“他可是堂堂的宇宙霸主之一，总会用此等自取其辱的方式！！”
天琊圣主则说道：“这不能怪黑暗主神，而是苏阳这家伙实在是太妖孽了，就刚才那种恐怖的手段，换做谁都得化为虚无。”
“而黑暗主神为了帮我们铲除苏阳，眼下也只能用这种方法。”
“就是不知道黑暗主神会不会给自己留有余地，毕竟一旦自爆黑暗宇宙之灵的话，后果会无比可怕。”
“哼，还真是高看他了，早知如此，都不需要苏阳出手，本天子就能将其击杀。”
天子冷哼出声，仿佛将黑暗主神逼到绝境的是他一样。
可麒凌风却眉头紧蹙，似乎没料到事情会发展成这样子。
如果黑暗主神真用如此疯狂的手段来结束战斗的话，恐怕整个宇宙世界都将会变得无比破败，甚至毫无用处。
除非神祇族长大人出手，否则整个宇宙世界都将倒退数个时代。
这对于自己的计划而言，十分不妙，麒凌风想了想，觉得必须要阻止黑暗主神这样做才行。
于是，还不等众人反应过来，麒凌风便消失在了原地，以极快的速度来到了黑暗宇宙中。
他看着不断吞噬黑暗宇宙之力的黑暗主神，神情冷漠道：“停止你现在的行动，否则我会用神祇之力助你一臂之力。”
看着现身而出的麒凌风，无论是黑暗主神还是苏阳等人，都显得十分诧异，仿佛没想到他会在这种情况下现身。

而黑暗主神则是嘴角上扬，露出十分癫狂的神情道：“呦，终于舍得现身了吗？麒凌风，看来你也害怕本始魔祖将整个宇宙世界给破坏啊。”
“少废话，只要你停止现在的举动，我会帮你对付苏阳。”
麒凌风十分平静的说道。
“哼，晚了！本始魔祖打算将你们所有人都一并解决。”
“管你什么神祇也好，不神祇也罢，事已至此，那就跟随本黑暗主神最后的手段而化为虚无吧。”
“哈哈哈哈哈！！！”
黑暗主神身体不断膨胀，他大笑出声，整个人如同气球般漂浮在宇宙之中，而四周的黑暗能量还在源源不断地涌入其体内。
特别是黑暗宇宙之心，正逐渐变得火热狂暴。
用不了多久便会彻底爆发，以黑暗主神的肉体为媒介，释放出足以毁灭整个宇宙世界的能量。
“你以为神祇族长大人会让你肆意妄为吗？”
“黑暗主神，你未免太高看自己了。”
“给我散！！！”
话音落下，麒凌风也不犹豫，立马释放出了自己体内那股磅礴的神祇之力。
刹那间，原本涌入黑暗主神体内的黑暗能量，竟在此刻变得无比缓慢。
见此一幕的苏阳瞳孔收缩道：“不对劲！麒凌风的神祇之力好像也变强了不少。”
不光苏阳察觉到了这一点，还有吴百炼等人也同样如此。
content_en:
"Don't say it's you, even we didn't expect that the Lord of Darkness would be forced to do this. Even the other two masters of the universe didn't do such crazy things before."
"Furthermore, the energy contained in the growth of the Dark Universe is unimaginable. Once the spirit of the Dark Universe is allowed to explode, it will inevitably cause devastating damage to the world."
"Even if all of us monks release their divine power to resist, it will not help."
Feng Ban said with a solemn expression.
The same was true for Ji Xuan on the side. He knew that in this situation, it was too late to say anything. He could only see if Su Yang could do anything else.
At the same time, Qi Lingfeng and others outside the Dead Soul Abyss were also extremely stunned.
The emperor was even more stunned and said: "Does the Lord of Darkness have no other means? He actually wants to end this battle in this way?"
"He is one of the majestic overlords of the universe, and he will always humiliate himself in such a way!!"
Holy Lord Tianya said: "This cannot be blamed on the Lord of Darkness, but this guy Su Yang is too evil. With the terrifying method just now, everyone would be reduced to nothingness."
"And in order to help us eradicate Su Yang, the Lord of Darkness can only use this method at the moment."
"I just don't know if the Lord of Darkness will leave any room for himself. After all, once the Dark Universe Spirit self-destructs, the consequences will be extremely terrifying."
"Hmph, I really think highly of him. If I had known this, I would have killed him without Su Yang taking action."
The Emperor snorted coldly, as if he was the one who forced the Lord of Darkness into a desperate situation.
But Qi Lingfeng frowned, as if he didn't expect things to develop like this.
If the Lord of Darkness really uses such crazy means to end the battle, I am afraid that the entire universe will become extremely dilapidated and even useless.
Unless the gods and patriarchs take action, the entire universe will be set back several eras.
This was very bad for his plan. Qi Lingfeng thought about it and felt that he had to stop the Lord of Darkness from doing this.
So, before anyone could react, Qi Lingfeng disappeared and entered the dark universe at an extremely fast speed.
He looked at the Dark Lord who was constantly devouring the power of the dark universe, and said with an indifferent expression: "Stop your current actions, otherwise I will use the power of the gods to help you."
Seeing Qi Lingfeng appearing, both the Lord of Darkness and Su Yang and others looked very surprised, as if they did not expect that he would appear under such circumstances.
The Lord of Darkness raised the corners of his mouth and said with a very crazy look: "Hey, are you finally willing to show up? Qi Lingfeng, it seems that you are also afraid that the original demon ancestor will destroy the entire universe."
"Stop talking nonsense, as long as you stop what you are doing now, I will help you deal with Su Yang."
Qi Lingfeng said very calmly.
"Hmph, it's too late! The original demon ancestor plans to deal with all of you at once."
"Whether you are a god or not, the matter has come to this, then follow this dark lord's last resort and turn into nothingness."
"Hahahahaha!!!"
The body of the Lord of Darkness continued to expand, and he laughed loudly. His whole body floated in the universe like a balloon, while the surrounding dark energy continued to pour into his body.
Especially the heart of the dark universe is gradually becoming fiery and violent.
It won't take long for it to explode completely, using the body of the Dark God as the medium to release energy enough to destroy the entire universe.
"Do you think the leader of the gods will let you do whatever you want?"
"Dark God, you think too highly of yourself."
"Let me go!!!"
As soon as the words fell, Qi Lingfeng did not hesitate and immediately released the majestic power of the gods in his body.
In an instant, the dark energy that originally poured into the body of the Dark Lord became extremely slow at this moment.
Seeing this scene, Su Yang's pupils shrank and said, "Something's wrong! Qi LingfengThe power of the gods seems to have become a lot stronger. "
Not only Su Yang noticed this, but Wu Bailian and others also did the same.
